diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate downward trend (a net fall of ~21% of its level). A moderate seasonal pattern is present. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (1 points, ~0% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.259), which favours a robust combination.
